summary: Comprehensive testing of ConnectClub CCP Pivot features. All backend APIs (21/21 tests) and frontend flows working correctly. Imago Imaging and Menio Global removed, Network page now serves as contact import hub with CCP opportunity flagging.

POST /api/network/contacts/bulk imports multiple contacts from CSV
GET /api/network/contacts returns contacts list with stats (total, opted_in, verified, flagged)
PATCH /api/network/contacts/{id}/opt-in toggles contact opt-in status
PATCH /api/network/contacts/{id}/verify triggers CCP analysis for restaurant/retail contacts
CCP analysis flags restaurant contacts with High probability match
CCP analysis returns Low probability for non-merchant businesses (software)
CCP analysis includes service, estimated_volume, potential_residual for High matches
GET /api/notifications returns CCP opportunity notifications
Notification created when contact is verified and CCP flagged
GET /api/promotions/targeted returns only 2 promotions (CCP + VA)
Imago Imaging and Menio Global NOT in promotions
CCP promotion has correct merchant services content (interchange, PCI)
DELETE /api/network/contacts/{id} removes contact
Auth protection on all network/notification endpoints (401 without auth)
Dashboard shows CCP Opportunities card with flagged contacts
Revenue Banner shows CCP Merchant Services promotion
Network page has manual entry form (name, business, industry, email, phone)
Network page has CSV upload, LinkedIn/Facebook/Instagram placeholders (disabled)
Network page filter dropdown has All/Opted In/Verified/CCP Flagged options
Commissions page shows CCP service card with ~25% commission, ~$150-$500 closing, ~$100-$1,000+ residual
Commissions page shows Interchange-plus, PCI compliance, POS integration terminology
Commissions page amounts prefixed with ~ and labeled as approximates
Marketplace CCP Accounts tab (renamed from High-Value)
Marketplace CCP cards are blue-themed with 'Request Merchant Analysis' button

CCP keywords for flagging: restaurant, retail, store, shop, cafe, bar, hotel, salon, spa, gym, clinic, dental, medical, food, merchant, ecommerce, hospitality, service, auto, repair, contractor, construction, real estate. Promotions endpoint returns only 2 items: connectclub-va and ccp-merchant-services (no imago-imaging or menio-global).
